title: Prime Counter
prompt:
Implement `int count_primes(int limit)` counting primes in [2, limit] (inclusive) using loops only. Also implement `void program(void)` printing exactly:

```
primes under 10: 4
2 3 5 7
```

Line 2 lists the primes 2..7 space-separated (single spaces, no trailing space).

tests.name: count is right
tests.hint: Trial division by every d from 2 while d*d <= n.

tests.name: exact program output
tests.code:
const char* out = cj_capture(program);
CHECK_STR_EQ(out, "primes under 10: 4\n2 3 5 7\n");
tests.hint: Reuse count_primes and a listing loop; guard the separator.
